title: checkpointEdits
responsibility: Pure edits of a game view's checkpoints: replace one, remove one with its requirements, and recognise a save conflict.

inputs.name: replaceCheckpoint.checkpoints
inputs.description: The checkpoints of the view, in order.

inputs.name: replaceCheckpoint.id
inputs.description: The id of the checkpoint to replace; null replaces none.

inputs.name: replaceCheckpoint.node
inputs.description: The edited checkpoint that takes the place of the one with that id.

inputs.name: withoutCheckpoint.checkpoints
inputs.description: The checkpoints of the view, in order.

inputs.name: withoutCheckpoint.id
inputs.description: The id of the checkpoint to remove.

inputs.name: isRevisionConflict.message
inputs.description: The text of a failed save.

outputs.name: replaceCheckpoint
outputs.description: The checkpoints in the same order with only the matching one replaced.

outputs.name: withoutCheckpoint
outputs.description: The checkpoints without the removed one, and with its id removed from every requirement.

outputs.name: isRevisionConflict
outputs.description: True when the message says the revision, a conflict, a stale state or a change.
